title: Campus Life & Daily Conversations (Listen and Type)
description: Listen to spoken English statements spoken by male and female voices and transcribe what you hear with up to 2 replays.

questions.text: The library will be open late during the week of final exams.
questions.explanation: Key phrases: 'will be open late' and 'during the week of final exams'.

questions.text: Please remember to bring your student ID card to the campus center tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Imperative instruction featuring 'remember to bring' and 'student ID card'.

questions.text: She completed her undergraduate degree in psychology before moving to New York.
questions.explanation: Past tense sentence with academic term 'undergraduate degree'.

questions.text: You can submit your assignment online through the student portal before midnight.
questions.explanation: Notice the modal verb phrase 'can submit' and prepositional phrase 'through the student portal'.

questions.text: Many students find it helpful to form study groups before midterm presentations.
questions.explanation: Syntactic structure: 'find it helpful to form study groups'.
